title: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says
description: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), a key national law enforcement database containing sensitive criminal justice information. The scope and impact of the breach are not yet clear. The FBI has declined to comment, and there is no indication that this incident is related to recent government and private sector outages. The NCIC database is widely used by local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies. The FBI has been a frequent target of cyberattacks in the past.
